methodology: Fresh question-independent production extraction and organization; both actual production QA entries; same deepseek-flash model and frozen QASPER100 paper-disjoint20/80 split. Same separated answer/memory/retrieval judge prompts, gold and labels. Anonymous previous/current answer pairing; preserve historical original scores separately. Gold never enters production. Complete provider-reported usage for every QA attempt including rejected reviews/fallbacks. No API retry or best-of selection; explicit pre-existing one-time parser/schema-only judge repair policy is unchanged and all costs retained. Failed pilots, if any, share600requests/3M development tokens and remain immutable artifacts. Full targets are registered reporting success targets, not permission to relax a development gate. These questions are fixed examined regressions, not unseen blind evaluation. Human semantic annotation is not complete.
snapshotPolicy: Previous qa-efficient production/evaluation snapshots and artifact hashes remain immutable. Shared tag dispatch may gain a new round route, changing its current bytes; the new round records a separate complete evaluation manifest and snapshot. Old artifacts are verified against their original snapshots; no historical fingerprint or result is rewritten.
